featuredAnimals.name: Brahma Hybrid Giant Bull
featuredAnimals.description: Massive Brahma cross bull featuring a large shoulder hump and deep chest structure. Raised in an eco-friendly farm environment in Comilla on high-protein silage, green forage, and mineral salt blocks. Demonstrates incredible muscle density, calm temperament, and complete health vitality. Managed under daily veterinary care with up-to-date vaccinations and deworming. Guaranteed to impress as a premier choice for festive Qurbani occasions.

featuredAnimals.name: Sirohi Spotted Buck
featuredAnimals.description: Handsome Sirohi breed goat with a shiny brown-spotted coat and strong, compact physique. Carefully hand-fed in Gazipur using organic tree leaves, mustard cake, and natural grain feeds. Known for high disease resistance and energetic nature, making it a reliable livestock option. Inspected and approved by certified local veterinary authorities with clear health certificates. Perfect selection for buyers seeking a healthy, medium-sized goat.

featuredAnimals.name: Tharparkar Desert Bull
featuredAnimals.description: Robust Tharparkar bull boasting a distinctive light gray coat and broad frame. Bred in Naogaon using zero-chemical pasture grazing combined with high-nutrition wheat bran diets. Highly resilient to heat and climate changes, maintaining steady weight gain and optimal stamina. Completely vaccinated and dewormed with clear medical records provided. A top-quality option offering balanced meat yield and prime health.

featuredAnimals.name: Kashmiri Long-Hair Goat
featuredAnimals.description: Stunning long-haired Kashmiri cross goat nurtured in the hill pastures of Sreemangal. Free-range grazed on organic tea estate grasses and fresh mountain forage to ensure top-tier meat texture. Possesses clear vision, pristine horn structure, and active physical mobility. Fully immunized against major livestock infections with official health clearance. An exclusive, high-stature goat designed for buyers wanting something truly distinct.

animals.name: Deshi Shahi Cow
animals.description: Healthy deshi cow suitable for Qurbani. Well fed with natural corn and fresh green grass. Raised under strict hygienic farm conditions in Bogura with regular veterinary care. This animal has completed full vaccination schedules and regular deworming cycles. Known for its gentle behavior, solid muscle structure, and superior quality meat. Highly recommended for families looking for an authentic local breed with a reliable health history.

animals.name: Premium Shahi Bull #SH-402
animals.description: This exceptional Shahi Bull is a prime example of its breed, known for high meat yield and docile nature. Raised under strict organic protocols in our Sirajganj farm, it has been fed a balanced diet of fresh green grass, corn flakes, wheat bran, and molasses. The animal has undergone complete veterinary health checkups including regular deworming and core vaccinations. Ideal for Qurbani, this bull offers a majestic presence and superior quality livestock heritage with full physical growth.

animals.name: Black Bengal Khasi
animals.description: Purebred Black Bengal goat raised naturally in the open pastures of Kushtia. Widely celebrated for its tender, high-protein meat and minimal fat ratio. Hand-fed organic tree leaves, mustard cake, and natural grain supplements without artificial growth hormones. Fully vaccinated, active, and thoroughly checked by certified livestock officers. Perfect choice for small family Qurbani rituals requiring top-grade local livestock.

animals.name: Red Chittagong Cattle
animals.description: Authentic Red Chittagong Cattle featuring a distinctive solid mahogany coat and strong bone structure. Nurtured on natural green pastures with balanced daily nutrition to maximize health and vitality. Highly adaptable to tropical climates and resistant to common cattle diseases. Passed all compulsory health tests with complete vaccination certification. Excellent selection for buyers looking for traditional Bangladeshi livestock.

animals.name: White Barbari Buck
animals.description: High-stature white Barbari goat with clean coat patterns and excellent posture. Raised in controlled farm settings in Jessore on high-energy forage, green grass, and mineral salts. Shows high physical activity, clear eyes, and firm horn structure. Fully dewormed and certified disease-free by local veterinary specialists. An attractive and premium choice for Qurbani celebrations.

animals.name: Sindhi Cross Bull
animals.description: Heavy-framed Red Sindhi cross bull boasting a well-developed hump and broad shoulder build. Carefully reared in Pabna district using traditional grass-feeding methods combined with high-protein pulse husks. Maintained under round-the-clock farm management to guarantee optimal weight gain without chemical additives. Comes with full medical records and health verification certificates. Ready for seamless booking and prompt delivery.

animals.name: Gir Breed Champion Cattle
animals.description: Magnificent Gir breed cattle displaying the signature convex forehead and long drooping ears. Bred in top-tier facilities in Dinajpur with focused attention on organic nutrition and overall well-being. Fed on green Napier grass, crushed maize, and fresh well water. Demonstrates exceptional temperament, strong muscle density, and full physical maturity. Includes guaranteed weight certificate and complimentary pre-delivery checkup.

animals.name: Jamunapari Tall Goat
animals.description: Tall, elegant Jamunapari goat featuring convex facial profile and long flat ears. Reared in rural farm pasturelands of Mymensingh with free-range grazing schedules. Consumes natural leaves, dry fodder, and mineral supplements to maintain peak health. Fully vaccinated against PPR and foot-and-mouth diseases. Offers impressive size and premium meat yield for sacrificial rituals.

animals.name: Holstein Friesian Cross
animals.description: Massive black and white Friesian cross bull built with impressive height and muscle mass. Carefully managed at a modern dairy and beef unit in Sylhet under professional supervision. Fed a rich diet of silage, green fodder, and balanced grain mixtures. Undergoes regular veterinary physical evaluations to maintain prime health. Ideal for buyers seeking a large, high-yielding bull for group or family booking.

animals.name: Kankrej Silver Bull
animals.description: Majestic Kankrej bull recognized by its impressive lyre-shaped horns and silver-gray coat. Grown in the nutrient-rich fields of Natore using zero-chemical organic feeding practices. Known for high endurance, strong immune system, and peaceful behavior around farm handlers. Thoroughly inspected by government vet medical teams with signed health clearance. A truly standout choice for Qurbani livestock.

animals.name: Rajshahi Royal Bull
animals.description: Magnificent Rajshahi hybrid bull raised in organic mango orchard pastures. Known for exceptionally gentle behavior, muscular frame, and prime health record. Fed on fresh green forage, rice bran, and natural minerals with up-to-date vaccinations and deworming clearance.
